name: Colorful Mirai
source:
Moving to a new city with a best friend and a heart full of hopes was the perfect scenario for the Heroine's new life. She knew from the beginning that fighting for her dream wouldn't be easy, but she also didn't expect the worst to happen.

One day, she woke up, and the only thing she could do was stare at the ceiling, unable to paint anymore. She couldn't feel anything nor see the colors surrounding her.

"Why do I still try?"
"What's the reason for working so hard on this? What am I doing here?"
"I'm useless..."

After all this time fighting against the world, the true challenge is about to start.

This game is about finding meaning and accepting who you are through love and pain.

[Edited from [url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/colorfulmirai]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和挚友一起搬到新城市，满怀希望地开启生活，对女主角而言，本该是再完美不过的新起点。她从一开始就知道，追逐梦想绝非易事，却也没想到，最糟糕的事竟真的会发生。

某天醒来，她除了望着天花板，什么也做不了，再也无法提笔作画。她感受不到任何东西，也看不见周围的色彩。

“我为什么还要努力？”
“这么拼命到底是为了什么？我究竟在这里做什么？”
“我真没用……”

与世界抗争了这么久，真正的挑战才即将开始。

这款游戏讲述如何在爱与痛苦之中寻找意义，接纳真实的自己。

[编译自[url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/colorfulmirai]itch.io[/url]]
